pages.text:
Wukong, Pigsy and Jade Rabbit are going
to the park.
Pigsy stands up very straight and
stops blinking.
“Today I am Robot Pigsy,” he says in a
beepy voice.
“I will do exactly what you tell me, in
exactly that order.”
2

Wukong is in a hurry, so he says the
steps very fast.
“Put on your shoes. Put on your socks.
Put on your hat. Put on your backpack.
Go out the door!”
Robot Pigsy beeps and starts with the
first step.
3

First, Robot Pigsy puts on his shoes.
Next, he pulls his socks on over his shoes!
“Wait, socks go first!” shouts Wukong.
Robot Pigsy says, “Beep. You said
shoes first.”
4

Then Wukong says, “Put on your hat,” and
Robot Pigsy puts the hat on his foot.
He does that because Wukong did not say
where the hat goes.
Wukong laughs so hard that he rolls on
the floor.
5

Robot Pigsy puts on his backpack and
clomps to the door in his socky shoes.
The hat wobbles on his foot.
Jade Rabbit giggles and says, “He did
every step you said, Wukong.
The steps just need to be clearer.”
6

Jade Rabbit brings some blank cards
and crayons.
“Let’s draw one step on each card,” she
says. “Then we put the cards in a row.
The robot follows them from left to right,
one card at a time.”
7

Wukong draws five cards: socks, shoes, a
hat, a backpack and the door.
On the hat card, he draws the hat on top
of a head.
When Robot Pigsy sees this card, he will
know exactly where the hat goes.
8

Wukong puts the shoes card first, but
Jade Rabbit points at it.
“Can you put on shoes before socks?”
she asks.
Wukong looks down at his own feet.
Then he moves the socks card to the
very front.
9

Now the row shows socks, shoes, hat,
backpack and door.
Wukong checks the cards one by one with
his finger.
Socks come before shoes, and the hat
goes on a head.
“This order works, so let’s try it!”
says Wukong.
10

Robot Pigsy takes off his hat, his socks
and his shoes, so he can start again.
He looks at the first card and puts on
his socks.
Then he looks at the second card and puts
on his shoes.
Beep, beep!
11

The third card shows a hat on a head, so
the hat goes on his head this time.
Then he puts on his backpack.
Last, he walks out the door.
Wukong and Jade Rabbit cheer, because
every step is in the right order.
12

At the park, Pigsy is not a robot anymore.
He grins and takes a peach and the
crayons from his backpack.
“Now you can be the robot, Wukong!”
he says.
Pigsy draws three cards: sit down, eat a
peach and hug Pigsy.
13

Robot Wukong stands very straight and
looks at the first card.
He sits down on the grass with a bump.
When he looks at the second card, he
eats the juicy peach in four big bites.
14

The third card shows a hug for Pigsy.
Robot Wukong walks over stiffly and gives
Pigsy a big, tight hug.
“Beep. That is the best step,” says
Robot Wukong.
Pigsy laughs and hugs him back.
15

Jade Rabbit lines up all the cards on
the bench.
“Who wants to be the robot next?”
she asks.
Wukong and Pigsy both put up
their hands.
“I do!” they shout together, and they
start to draw new cards.
16
